resources.string: Sound in the Middle of the Night
When I got home from work, an unexpected package was waiting for me. It was a birthday gift from a close friend. It was a really happy day.
I\'m planning my trip for next week. My heart pounds every time I look at the plane tickets. I want to leave already!
I finally successfully finished the project that had been tormenting me for months. I will never forget the thrill of finishing the final report in front of my team members. I did it.
I laughed for a long time at an animal video a colleague showed me during lunch. It was a really fun time to laugh without thinking.
I walked along the riverbank with my lover and watched the sunset. The moment we walked holding hands, it felt romantic as if we were the only two in the world.
I thought my senior was really cool during the company presentation today. I want to emulate that logical and confident appearance. They are like an idol to me.
I was completely captivated by the main character\'s gaze and atmosphere in the movie. Everything about that person felt so attractive that I think it will be hard to fall asleep tonight.
I drank warm tea while watching the rain fall outside the window. Listening to the sound of the rain calmed my complicated mind.
I finished all my planned tasks and am listening to my favorite music. It is a satisfying evening without any complaints.
I found a really beautiful painting at the art museum I visited after a long time. The colors and composition were so perfect that I couldn\'t take my feet off it for a long time.
The night sky I saw at the campground was truly spectacular. Looking at the stars that seemed to pour down, I felt an ecstatic feeling as if my sense of reality was disappearing.
I heard the story of my teacher who has always walked his own path silently and consistently. I felt a sense of respect for his depth and wisdom.
Standing in front of the huge waterfall, I felt overwhelmed by its grandeur. I felt a sense of awe for nature, realizing how small humans are.
I heard a friend talk about coding, which they newly started. I became curious about a new world I don\'t know and became interested in learning it.
My beloved pet crossed the rainbow bridge. The empty space feels so big that I keep crying. It\'s so sad.
While cleaning the warehouse, I found an old album from my childhood. I miss those days when I used to play with the friends in the pictures.
I listened to my friend who is going through a hard time. My heart ached because I could fully understand how they felt.
I watched a documentary about children suffering from war. Their pain felt like my own, and my heart ached as if it were being torn apart.
I\'m so angry at a colleague at work who casually takes credit for my efforts and achievements. I feel a surge of anger at the unfair situation.
A strange sound came from outside my house when I was alone in the middle of the night. I was scared to death thinking that someone might be there.
As I turned the corner of a dark alley, a human figure suddenly popped out and I screamed. I felt extreme horror as if my heart had stopped.
I have an important presentation tomorrow, and I don\'t know if I can do well. What if I make a mistake? I\'m so anxious and nervous that I can\'t get anything done.
My head is a mess because of my boss\'s conflicting instructions. I\'m so confused because I don\'t know what to do.
Today was the same as yesterday. Time flowing by without any special events feels so boring.
I rode the elevator alone with a boss I\'m not very close to. It was so awkward that we just stared at the ceiling because we didn\'t know what to say.
The table at the restaurant I went to for lunch was so dirty. When I found a hair in my food, I felt nauseous and disgusted.
I heard that my friend, who joined the company at the same time as me, got promoted before me. I know I should congratulate them, but I can\'t help but feel envious on one side of my heart.
The results of the exam I have been preparing for a long time will be released tomorrow. I really want to pass this time. I can\'t sleep and just pray earnestly.
I had kimchi stew for lunch and soybean paste stew for dinner. I completed 3 items on my to-do list today.
